description: A new visit, macro choices left to their defaults. prepended: one prepend, a blank line before
the sections. appended: one append after them. both: two prepends and two appends, each place
in placement order. gated: new_visit_note's own if holds; review_note's placement if does not,
so it is not placed; review_leaflet is placed but renders empty, and its empty piece still takes
its place in the blank-line join (four newlines). optional: followup_offer (default on) is
placed and leaflet_offer (default off) is not. authored: one macro reads profile.name,
run.date (the run's date, 2026-11-10) and profile.signature, so it carries the signature text
itself. sections_note: in each loop item, section_intro is placed before the reply and
section_close after it, gated by the item (it holds for History and not for Plan); History's
reply ends in a blank line, which stays inside the item's text (only the item's ends are
trimmed). signed_letter: signature true, so the profile's signature block follows the appended

inputs.consult_draft: Margaret Okafor, 71, seen for palpitations. Holter shows paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. Started apixaban. (Fictional.)

outputs.section_draft:0: History paragraph: palpitations for two months.
outputs.letter_body: Letter body: palpitations from paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
